name: frontend-dependency-docs
body: README.md (and the pipeline section of AGENTS.md) documents the frontend dependency contract. README.md currently names six of the eight languages (Python and Markdown are missing), lists only `java` and `node` as scan-time dependencies (`go` and `cargo`/`rustc` are undocumented), omits `src/pylib` and `src/mdlib` from the project layout, and describes a stale build (`cmake` plus a "bundled LadybugDB", whereas the real build links a prebuilt static `liblbug` and `openssl@3`). Acceptance: a reader can determine, per frontend, the build-time deps, the scan-time deps, and the engine pin from README.md, and the project layout lists all eight frontend sources.
